function t1.Image(p3, p4, p5, p6, p7) -- line: 100
	-- upvalues: T (copy)
	assert(T.string(p4))
	assert(T.string(p5))
	assert(T.string(p6) or T.none(p6))
	assert(T.string(p7) or T.none(p7))
	p3._images = {
		Normal = p4,
		Shiny = p5,
		Mythic = p6,
		MythicShiny = p7
	}

	return p3
end
itemUtilSelection: Pets[item.Name].Images[(item.Mythic and "Mythic" or "") .. (item.Shiny and "Shiny" or "")] (or Normal when neither)
